entries.summary: Tightened wording after cross-model legal review: delivery scope now defers to each Statement of Work; data-rights and measurement details defer to the signed agreement; material-change notice narrowed to these Service Terms; the penalty-free exit during the 30-day objection window is stated in full.
Initial publication of the BWM Service Terms. First versioned release of the methodology and tooling details our client agreements point to, together with this changelog.
